title: Text: DET Jay Sartori ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: What do you think of the Mets hiring Brodie Van Wagonen as GM?
I wish it was me.  I’d like a pay raise.
That’s a surprisingly good answer.
That stays here, clearly
A) yeah, B) Trust-building exercise
Yeah duh
I think it’s so Mets. Clown show.
He’s a very smart guy, it’s their business, their choice.
And I don’t like the precedent that’s been set, because you know there’s a bunch of agents whose eyes have opened
Huge conflict of interest, even if indirectly
I think the deal is that if you’re smart and work hard, and someone wants to hire you then good for you.
It’s a free country
Regardless - and I could be completely off-base - he’s got enough baseball smarts to be a GM
And having the keys to a team is very rare
If he doesn’t, the NY papers will be there to point it out
There are 30 of them
I’d rather run a team than be an agent. He’s already set for life financially if he’s not an idiot.
I’d rather be set for life financially
I’d agree
But if you already are, then what the hell?
Right. Do what you want to do.
Not like he’s making minimum wage with this job, either - win or lose
Oh I’m sure he isn’t
I just don’t like it. I’m a curmudgeon, though. Don’t like opening this box to agents, who are generally dicks, or passing baseball people who have put the time in, though
I think there are worse injustices
If you own a billion dollar team, it’s your prerogative
For sure, on both counts
But when your billion dollar team is the Mets, and you make this move
It’s typical
I’ll reserve judgement until after he performs duties.  If he’s good, they made the right move.
Yep
You can’t write this, but I hope he falls flat on his face and it implodes gloriouslyZ
No rooting in the press box, though!
When he does, they’ll think...we could have had Sartori!
Liked “When he does, they’ll think...we could have had Sartori!”
Or Dave Littlefield
It’s 3:09 a.m. in Malta. Goodnight, Jay
Liked “It’s 3:09 a.m. in Malta. Goodnight, Jay”
